name: code-delegate
description: Parallel AI coding agents — free local LLMs or cloud APIs, with test gates and review-before-merge

plugins.name: code-delegate
plugins.description: Offload implementation tasks to AI coding agents in isolated Git worktrees. Use local LLMs for free (OpenCode + Ollama/LM Studio) or cloud APIs (Claude, Codex). Parallel dispatch, per-task model selection, stall detection, failure loop prevention, and test gates.
